about.title: A Century of Preservation
about.subtitle: Dedicated to preserving and celebrating the rich tapestry of human history.
about.text1: Founded over a century ago, The Grand Museum stands as one of the world's premier institutions for the study and appreciation of ancient civilizations. Our collection spans five continents and thousands of years of human achievement.
about.text2: We are committed to making history accessible to everyone through innovative exhibitions, educational programs, and community outreach initiatives.

gallery.title: Journey Through History Museum Rooms
gallery.intro: Begin our journey inside the museum... where each room tells a chapter of the Egyptian Army's history over seven thousand years.
gallery.room1_desc: Witness King Narmer uniting the two lands, leading the first organized army with stone and leather weapons.
gallery.room2_desc: The Army of the Pyramid Builders. Copper weapons, strict organization, and protection of expeditions.
gallery.room3_desc: Renewed strength... developed axes, wooden shields, and fortresses extending south towards Nubia.
gallery.room4_desc: The Era of Empire. Complete war chariots, composite bows, and bronze Khopesh swords.
gallery.room5_desc: A mixed army of Egyptians and Greek mercenaries. Hoplon shields and Phalanx spears.
gallery.room6_desc: Scutum shields, Gladius swords, long Sarissas, and heavy iron helmets.
gallery.room7_desc: Curved swords, chainmail, Ayyubid and Mamluk knights facing Crusaders.
gallery.room8_desc: The strongest knights of the East. Composite bows, scale armor, and Turkish swords.
gallery.room9_desc: The Era of Gunpowder. Matchlock muskets, massive cannons, and Janissary uniforms.
gallery.room10_desc: The birth of the modern army. The Tarbush, military schools, and European rifles.
gallery.room11_desc: July Revolution, professional national army, and the October War room.
gallery.room12_desc: Nasser's pistol, Sadat's watch, Mubarak's helmet, and Shazly's handwritten maps.
gallery.room13_desc: Crawling tunnels, climbing walls, and interactive maps teaching children about national defense.
gallery.conclusion: This is a complete history... civilization... and heroism... an army that preserved Egypt for seven thousand years.
